visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with styled, long wavy dark hair and a beige knitted vest over a white long-sleeved blouse stands centrally. She is framed from the chest up in a well-lit indoor space. Behind her are light-colored wooden shelves holding a green bird figurine and various books. She greets the camera by pressing her palms together in a traditional respectful gesture, showing a friendly smile. (2) As she speaks, she uses expressive hand gestures to emphasize her points, her fingers adorned with rings and her wrists with multiple beaded bracelets. The top of the frame features a green and blue text banner titled "立夏開運3秘法". Her earrings are large, red, and ornate, swaying as she moves her head. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her clear facial features. (3) She demonstrates the first tip by moving her hands apart in a wide, sweeping motion at face level, as if opening a window or embracing the sun. Her mouth is wide open in speech, and her eyes are bright with enthusiasm. The background remains a static indoor studio environment with soft, warm light filtering from the side. (4) While discussing the second tip, she raises her right hand to the camera, clearly displaying all five fingers. She wears a large green jade ring on her thumb and another on her finger. Her movements are deliberate and rhythmic, matching her speech pattern. The text overlay at the top shifts to "1. 旭日升起天地旺" during this segment. (5) She transitions to the third tip, forming a heart shape with both hands in front of her chest to represent "roundness" or "harmony". Her facial expression remains warm and welcoming. She is wearing a pearl necklace and several layered chains. The background shelves remain visible, containing a decorative globe and small green plants. (6) To conclude, she gives two enthusiastic thumbs-up gestures toward the camera, her smile widening. She then returns to the initial posture with her palms pressed together in front of her heart, bowing her head slightly in a parting salute. The graphic style text at the bottom and her name label on the left remain constant.
